/* Generated by mlc - Mathless C ABI header for module 'add'. Do not edit.
 * This GENERATOR is verified by acceptance D, both ways a C host can consume it:
 * a C11 host built with MSVC cl on Windows x64 compiles this output and calls the
 * module through LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress (hosts/c-host), and a second host links
 * against the packaged <module>.lib and calls it with no run-time lookup at all
 * (hosts/c-host-link). The output also compiles as C++ (cl /TP). That covers the
 * generator, not this particular file.
 * Not verified: any C or C++ compiler other than MSVC.
 * `bool` is 1 byte to match the module's extern "C" ABI (D18). */
#ifndef ML_ADD_H
#define ML_ADD_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

/* Interface fingerprint of THIS header. Compare it against the module's
 * ml_iface_hash() right after loading, and REFUSE the module when they differ:
 * export names are identical across incompatible interfaces, so resolution
 * succeeds and the call is then a wrong value or an access violation (measured).
 *
 *   if (ml_iface_hash() != ML_ADD_IFACE_HASH) {
 *       return -1;      // built against a different interface: call nothing
 *   }
 *
 * A change to a function BODY does not change this value; a change to a name,
 * type, parameter order, out-ness or error code does. */
#define ML_ADD_IFACE_HASH 0x224A2953E2699E31ULL

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#ifndef ML_CARRIER_H
#define ML_CARRIER_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

/* Interface fingerprint of THIS header. Compare it against the module's
 * ml_iface_hash() right after loading, and REFUSE the module when they differ:
 * export names are identical across incompatible interfaces, so resolution
 * succeeds and the call is then a wrong value or an access violation (measured).
 *
 *   if (ml_iface_hash() != ML_CARRIER_IFACE_HASH) {
 *       return -1;      // built against a different interface: call nothing
 *   }
 *
 * A change to a function BODY does not change this value; a change to a name,
 * type, parameter order, out-ness or error code does. */
#define ML_CARRIER_IFACE_HASH 0xC8D1191E339AAF6EULL

/* Q12 caller-allocates protocol: a buffer too small to hold the
 * result, NUL included. Truncation is a FAILURE, not a short
 * success - nothing is written, and *ml_needed is the exact size
 * to allocate, in the same unit as ml_cap. */
#ifndef ML_ST_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER
#define ML_ST_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER (-1)
#endif

#define ML_ERR_E_UNKNOWN_SCAC 1

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

uint32_t ml_module_abi_version(void);
uint64_t ml_iface_hash(void);
/* may fail with: ML_ERR_E_UNKNOWN_SCAC */
int32_t mlx_carrier_name(const char* scac, char* ml_buf, int32_t ml_cap, int32_t* ml_needed);
/* may fail with: (no domain error) */
int32_t mlx_carrier_label(const char* scac, int32_t* tier, char* ml_buf, int32_t ml_cap, int32_t* ml_needed);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ML_CARRIER_H */
